attractions.name: Sangeh Monkey Forest
attractions.description: Walk through towering nutmeg trees, cool shade, and quiet temple courtyards inhabited by playful grey macaques

attractions.name: Ubud Palace
attractions.description: Beautiful introduction to Balinese royal architecture - carved sandstone gates, ornate wooden doors, and courtyards glowing in golden light

attractions.name: Ubud Art Market
attractions.description: One of Bali's most famous shopping destinations located directly opposite Ubud Palace. Colourful stalls overflow with handmade crafts, woven bags, silver jewellery, batik fabrics, paintings, wood carvings, and unique Balinese souvenirs.
source_files: Bali Indonesia/Peter - Bali - All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Tegalalang Rice Terrace
attractions.description: One of Bali's most iconic landscapes showcasing centuries-old Subak irrigation systems. Walking through narrow pathways between paddies offers a glimpse into traditional Balinese farming life.

attractions.name: Tegenungan Waterfall
attractions.description: A powerful 66-foot cascade in a jungle setting, offers a refreshing dip and iconic photo ops

attractions.name: Bali Safari & Marine Park
attractions.description: Immersive park home to over 100 species, including Komodo dragons, orangutans, and Bengal tigers. Enjoy tram safaris, animal encounters, and cultural performances

attractions.name: Campuhan Ridge Walk
attractions.description: Scenic 2-km walk along a grassy ridge offers panoramic views of the Ubud hills

attractions.name: Outback Ubud Adventure
attractions.description: ATV adventure through Ubud's picturesque landscapes
attractions.entry_fee: 345,000 IDR for single and 575,000 IDR for tandem

attractions.name: Ubud Palace (Puri Saren Agung)
attractions.description: One of Bali's most important cultural landmarks, once the residence of Ubud's royal family. Features beautifully preserved Balinese architecture, intricate stone carvings, traditional courtyards, and ornate gateways.
source_files: Bali Indonesia/Peter - Bali - All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Saraswati Temple
attractions.description: Famed for its lotus-covered ponds, this temple feels serene and poetic

attractions.name: Pura Taman Kemuda Saraswati (Water Palace)
attractions.description: Lotus ponds, temple carvings, and still reflective waters make this one of Ubud's most photogenic corners

attractions.name: Alas Harum & Super Extreme Swing
attractions.description: Scenic complex overlooking dramatic valley with giant bamboo nests, jungle swings, coffee plantations, and layered infinity-style terraces

attractions.name: Ubud River Rafting
attractions.description: River rafting adventure

attractions.name: Alas Harum
attractions.description: Alas Harum in Bali offers thrilling ziplining and various Bali swing experiences that soar high above lush rice terraces and jungle landscapes, providing breathtaking views and excellent photo opportunities

attractions.name: Traditional Balinese Dance Performance – Ubud Palace Courtyard
attractions.description: Traditional gamelan music, elaborate costumes, expressive storytelling, and hypnotic performances bringing ancient Balinese legends to life in the palace courtyard.

attractions.name: WS Art Studio Silver Class
attractions.description: Hands-on silver jewellery-making workshop guided by skilled local artisans. Learn the basics of shaping, carving, and polishing silver before creating your own unique keepsake.

attractions.name: Ayung River Rafting
attractions.description: One of Bali's most scenic white-water rafting experiences through lush rainforest valleys, passing cascading waterfalls, dramatic rock carvings, and hidden stretches of jungle. Suitable for beginners.

attractions.name: Tibumana Waterfall
attractions.description: Hidden within a lush tropical valley, a beautiful single-drop waterfall cascading into a calm natural pool surrounded by dense greenery. Retains a serene atmosphere unlike busier waterfalls.

attractions.name: Kamandalu Spa Ubud
attractions.description: Surrounded by rice terraces and tropical gardens, offering traditional Balinese therapies, aromatic oils, and tranquil treatment pavilions. Offers traditional Balinese massage, body scrub, and signature wellness rituals.
attractions.entry_fee: Approx. INR 4,500–9,000 per person depending on treatment

attractions.name: Tirta Ganga Water Palace
attractions.description: Once the royal water palace of Karangasem, one of East Bali's most picturesque landmarks. Features elegant fountains, koi-filled ponds, stone pathways, and beautifully landscaped gardens.

attractions.name: Tirta Empul Temple
attractions.description: One of Bali's most sacred temples, founded more than a thousand years ago. Renowned for its holy spring water believed to possess powerful purification properties. Features traditional courtyards, ornate shrines, and famous purification pools where worshippers participate in sacred cleansing rituals.
source_files: Bali Indonesia/Peter - Bali - All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Ubud Jungle Swing
attractions.description: Soar above lush rice terraces and tropical valleys. Offers breathtaking views and fantastic photo opportunities. Various swing options and photo spots available.

attractions.name: Outback Adventure ATV Ride (Tandem)
attractions.description: Exciting tandem ATV experience through Bali's rural landscapes including jungle tracks, village pathways, muddy trails, and scenic countryside.

attractions.name: Kamandaka SPA
attractions.description: Tranquil wellness sanctuary surrounded by lush tropical greenery and valley views. Features elegant treatment rooms, jacuzzis, and a serene atmosphere for traditional Balinese healing therapies.
attractions.entry_fee: Approx. INR 4,500–9,000 per person depending on treatment

attractions.name: Tegallalang Rice Terrace
attractions.description: One of Bali's most photographed landscapes nestled within a lush valley north of Ubud. Showcases Bali's traditional Subak irrigation system, a UNESCO-recognised farming practice. Features layered emerald-green terraces with breathtaking panoramic views.
source_files: Bali Indonesia/Peter - Bali - All Inclusive Guide.docx

health_tips.tip: Temperatures at the Mount Batur summit can feel surprisingly cool before sunrise — carry a light fleece or jacket for the trek.
Mambal Medical Care Ubud is available 24/7, approximately 10 minutes walk from The Samaya Ubud.
Apotek Ubud 9 Jaya (Sayan) pharmacy is open 24/7, approximately 10 minutes walk from The Samaya Ubud.
Nearest 24/7 medical facility near Kayumanis Ubud: Mambal Medical Care Ubud (approx. 12 min walk).
Nearest pharmacy near Kayumanis Ubud: Apotek Mika Sayan (approx. 7 min walk, open 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM).
Nearby medical facility: Ari Canti Hospital, approximately 5 minutes from Mayura Ubud Retreat, open 24/7.
health_tips._source_file: Bali Indonesia/Peter - Bali - All Inclusive Guide.docx

health_tips.tip: Nearby pharmacy: APOTEK ADAPOTEK MAS, approximately 4 minutes from Mayura Ubud Retreat, open 24/7.
